answer: Exclusive collateral nullifiers stop one deposit from backing many seats. Each identity locks a 500 POA bond and publishes a nullifier derived from those exact coins; any registry or jury pool that sees a nullifier already in use refuses the new seat. The scarce pearl is locked capital: 100 personas need 100 separate bonds, 50,000 POA idle while they want to earn. Recycling fails because the tag follows the coins, not the key, so a bond routed down a river of fresh wallets keeps its old nullifier, and even one copper of overlap is caught.
